design.purpose: A warm two-colour cowl for one adult, crocheted flat in chunky single crochet and joined into a tube. Confirm enough yarn for about 25 × 60 cm before starting; skein quantity is not known from the photo.

steps.c: Place the green yarn on the work surface
Place the blue yarn beside the green yarn
Ch 41 with green. Row 1: sc in 2nd ch, sc across
Rows 2–8: ch 1, turn, sc in each of 40 sts
Rows 9–16: ch 1, turn, sc in each of 40 sts
Fasten off, leaving a 60 cm blue tail for seaming
Fold panel, whipstitch the 25 cm ends together with tail
Weave all tails through stitches and trim close
